title: Terrain Filesystem Object Structure
description: JSON structure documentation for iRODS filesystem objects in the CyVerse Discovery Environment

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique iRODS data object or collection ID

fields.name: date-created
fields.description: Creation timestamp in milliseconds since epoch

fields.name: date-modified
fields.description: Last modification timestamp in milliseconds since epoch

fields.name: file-size
fields.description: File size in bytes (0 for directories)

fields.name: permission
fields.description: Access permission for the current user: read, write, or own

fields.name: file-type
fields.description: MIME type or DE-detected file type (e.g., text/plain, image/png)

fields.name: folders
fields.description: Sub-directories when listing a directory (only in directory listing response)

fields.name: files
fields.description: Files when listing a directory (only in directory listing response)

fields.name: total
fields.description: Total count of objects in directory (for pagination)
